what.text: This page follows Tibetan refugees living in Nepal, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12540 Tibetan refugees in Nepal, 99.7% of all Tibetan refugees it counts.
Very small numbers of Tibetan refugees live in France, Belgium and Australia.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data run from 1983 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1964 at 7000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 20471, at the end of 1997, and was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nepal.
These are year-end totals for Nepal only, reported to UNHCR.
